Additionally, a solid knowledge base in mechanical engineering, technology, design, and engineering principles is essential for success in this field. By leveraging these critical competencies, professionals in this role can effectively contribute to the advancement and optimization of machinery and equipment in various industries.

5831f046df1aadfc72cfe2b157d894f2f8bba5ad.data: Automotive Engineering Technicians play a crucial role in assisting engineers with evaluating proposed product design changes and conducting tests on experimental equipment to assess performance, durability, and efficiency. Key competencies for this role include strong reading comprehension, critical thinking, and active listening skills. Additionally, a solid foundation in mechanical, engineering, and technology knowledge is essential, along with proficiency in computers and electronics, as well as a strong grasp of mathematics. By leveraging these critical competencies, Automotive Engineering Technicians contribute to the development and improvement of automotive technologies and products.

272374ad012a83ef6fa8d38cdbef4b5a7f695a59.data: Non-Destructive Testing Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring the safety and integrity of various structures, vehicles, and vessels by utilizing advanced equipment such as x-ray, ultrasound, and fiber optics. They are skilled in quality control analysis, reading comprehension, and active listening, allowing them to accurately interpret test results and identify potential issues. In addition, they possess knowledge in engineering and technology, education and training, computers and electronics, mathematics, and physics, which enables them to effectively perform their duties and make informed decisions. Overall, Non-Destructive Testing Specialists are essential professionals who contribute to the maintenance of safety standards in a wide range of industries.

d9fa40a8a56d9b1e82459db3c27cd1e06fb420f5.data: Photonics Technicians are responsible for constructing, installing, testing, and maintaining optical and fiber optic equipment, including lasers, lenses, and mirrors. They utilize spectrometers, interferometers, and other related equipment to ensure the proper functioning of these devices. Key competencies for Photonics Technicians include reading comprehension, critical thinking, troubleshooting, and active listening. They must possess knowledge in computers and electronics, engineering and technology, mechanical principles, and mathematics to effectively carry out their duties. Overall, Photonics Technicians play a crucial role in the field of photonics by ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of optical equipment.

876be004b6950b444260b80cad164c8d511bab11.data: Surveying and Mapping Technicians play a crucial role in obtaining data for various purposes such as construction, mapmaking, and boundary location. Working under the guidance of professionals like engineers, surveyors, and cartographers, they utilize their skills in reading comprehension, active listening, and mathematics to calculate mapmaking information and create accurate maps. They rely on sources like surveying notes, aerial photography, and satellite data to depict topographical features, political boundaries, and other important aspects. Attention to detail is essential as they verify the accuracy and completeness of maps. In addition to their technical skills, they possess knowledge in geography, computers and electronics, and design, enabling them to effectively carry out their duties in the field.

aef524a67b6c9533d28fbf37d34fa4a8c68fc069.data: Animal scientists conduct research in various areas related to domestic farm animals, including genetics, nutrition, reproduction, growth, and development. They utilize key skills such as reading comprehension, judgment and decision making, critical thinking, and writing to analyze data and draw conclusions. A strong foundation in biology, mathematics, and chemistry is essential for understanding the complex biological processes involved in animal science. Additionally, proficiency in the English language is crucial for effectively communicating research findings. Continuous education and training are also important for staying current with advancements in the field. Overall, animal scientists play a vital role in advancing knowledge and improving practices related to the care and management of farm animals.

c6068badacf053a23f33b0ac2082f155b88638e9.data: Food Scientists and Technologists utilize a combination of chemistry, microbiology, and engineering to investigate the fundamental principles governing food processing and spoilage. By analyzing food composition to assess nutrient levels and exploring novel food sources, they strive to enhance the safety, taste, and nutritional value of processed foods. Their expertise in food science guides them in determining the most effective methods for processing, packaging, preserving, storing, and distributing food products. Critical competencies for this role include reading comprehension, critical thinking, and active listening, along with a strong knowledge base in chemistry, biology, food production, and processing techniques. Proficiency in the English language is also essential for effective communication within this field.

54bc9a6673ff779162063c577c70c5b77b9ff6d8.data: Soil and Plant Scientists conduct research on various aspects of crops, agricultural plants, and soils to enhance production and manage pests effectively. They study the breeding, physiology, and growth of plants in different soil conditions, as well as analyze the chemical, physical, and biological composition of soils to understand their impact on plant growth. These scientists may also classify and map soils, and investigate the effects of different agricultural practices on soil and crop productivity. Key skills for this role include reading comprehension, active learning, and effective communication through speaking and writing. In terms of knowledge, a strong background in biology, mathematics, and chemistry is essential, along with proficiency in education and training, computers, and electronics.

e06c9668bc4b55051f62c56c5b7e18240a31e27c.data: Biochemists and biophysicists are professionals who study the chemical composition and physical principles of living cells and organisms, as well as their electrical and mechanical energy. They conduct research to gain a deeper understanding of the complex chemical combinations and reactions involved in metabolism, reproduction, growth, and heredity. Additionally, they investigate the effects of various substances such as foods, drugs, serums, and hormones on tissues and vital processes of living organisms. To excel in this field, individuals must possess key skills such as reading comprehension, active learning, writing, science, and critical thinking. They should also have a strong foundation in key knowledges including biology, mathematics, chemistry, physics, and the English language.

bea0b4dd289741f41b711f9601064647b8a805aa.data: Microbiologists are professionals who delve into the intricate world of microscopic organisms, such as bacteria, algae, and fungi. They investigate the growth, structure, development, and other characteristics of these tiny life forms, with a focus on understanding their behavior and impact. This includes medical microbiologists who specifically study the relationship between organisms and disease, as well as the effects of antibiotics on microorganisms. To excel in this field, microbiologists must possess key competencies such as reading comprehension, critical thinking, and strong scientific writing skills. They must also have a solid foundation in biology and chemistry, along with knowledge in education and training, as well as proficiency in computers and electronics. By combining these critical competencies with a passion for the microscopic world, microbiologists play a crucial role in advancing our understanding of these tiny yet powerful organisms.

88f6decedd405ccd04a7550ca15b9c8371c2556b.data: Zoologists and Wildlife Biologists study the origins, behavior, diseases, genetics, and life processes of animals and wildlife, with a potential specialization in wildlife research and management. They collect and analyze biological data to assess the environmental impacts of land and water habitat use. Key skills for this role include reading comprehension, writing, judgment and decision making, and active listening. Key knowledge areas include biology, customer and personal service, English language, and geography. This profession requires a deep understanding of animal biology and ecology, as well as strong communication and analytical skills to effectively research and manage wildlife populations and habitats.

858abf289dda7bb6b6ec7ca0f715132a29ede3d7.data: Bioinformatics Scientists conduct research in various fields such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and computational biology using bioinformatics theory and methods. They may design databases and develop algorithms to process and analyze genomic and other biological information. Key competencies for this role include reading comprehension, writing, active listening, critical thinking, and speaking. Key knowledge areas include biology, computers and electronics, mathematics, and biology. This role requires a strong foundation in both biological sciences and computer information science to effectively analyze and interpret complex biological data.

08cd0265e3ec66c73541fc89dcb5431d66227a7d.data: Molecular and Cellular Biologists are professionals who research and study cellular molecules and organelles to gain a deeper understanding of cell function and organization. They possess key competencies in reading comprehension, writing, science, critical thinking, and speaking. In order to excel in this field, they must have a strong foundation in biology, English language, education and training, chemistry, and mathematics. By leveraging these critical competencies and knowledge areas, Molecular and Cellular Biologists are able to conduct groundbreaking research and contribute to advancements in the field of cellular biology.

96cdb8fcbf234c2ecc689dd0406564fcc334b751.data: Geneticists are professionals who research and analyze the inheritance of traits at various levels, including molecular, organism, and population. They may also work with patients who have genetic disorders, evaluating and providing treatment. Key competencies for geneticists include strong skills in reading comprehension, writing, science, and critical thinking. They must possess a deep knowledge of biology, education and training, English language, and mathematics to excel in their field. By combining these skills and knowledges, geneticists are able to make significant contributions to the understanding and advancement of genetics.

ed6fde638eb1619f03fc870d076f1cd2ae480dc5.data: Biologists research and study the fundamental principles of plant and animal life, including their origins, relationships, development, anatomy, and functions. They possess key skills in reading comprehension, science, writing, and active learning, allowing them to effectively analyze and interpret complex biological data. In addition, biologists have a strong knowledge base in biology, mathematics, and the English language, enabling them to communicate their findings effectively. They also excel in providing exceptional customer and personal service, demonstrating their ability to work collaboratively with others in the scientific community.

83284f40d72ddd08448e535bd449daa4f4f56154.data: Conservation Scientists are responsible for managing, improving, and protecting natural resources to ensure sustainable use while preserving the environment. They may conduct soil surveys, develop erosion control plans, and provide guidance to farmers and ranchers on conservation practices such as crop rotation and terracing. Key skills for this role include reading comprehension, active listening, and writing, while essential knowledge areas encompass geography, biology, mathematics, customer service, and the English language. By applying their expertise in these areas, Conservation Scientists play a crucial role in promoting environmental stewardship and sustainable resource management.

04541b92af0e47538d19680a150c63ff5c135ae1.data: Range Managers are responsible for researching and studying range land management practices to ensure the sustained production of forage, livestock, and wildlife. They must possess key skills such as monitoring, reading comprehension, active listening, and complex problem-solving to effectively carry out their duties. Additionally, a strong knowledge base in English language, biology, geography, education and training, and administrative tasks is essential for success in this role. By utilizing these critical competencies, Range Managers can effectively manage and maintain range lands to support the needs of both agricultural production and wildlife conservation.

bb576df2e813630540df22322bef8625698d328a.data: Park Naturalists are responsible for planning, developing, and conducting programs that educate the public on the historical, natural, and scientific aspects of national, state, or local parks. They must possess strong speaking, reading comprehension, active listening, and writing skills to effectively communicate with park visitors. Additionally, they should have knowledge in customer and personal service, education and training, English language, and geography to provide informative and engaging experiences for park guests. Overall, Park Naturalists play a crucial role in promoting environmental awareness and appreciation among the public through their educational programs and interactions.

be98a1f808b98ad19722f365d458ec1a2efde13e.data: Foresters are responsible for managing both public and private forested lands, with a focus on economic, recreational, and conservation objectives. They conduct inventories of standing timber, assess its value, negotiate purchases, and draft procurement contracts. Additionally, foresters work to preserve wildlife habitats, water quality, and soil stability, while ensuring compliance with environmental regulations. They also develop plans for tree planting and growth, monitor tree health, and establish optimal harvesting schedules. Key competencies for foresters include writing, complex problem solving, judgment and decision making, reading comprehension, and active listening. They must also possess knowledge in customer and personal service, administration and management, biology, mathematics, and the English language.

ee5b749ea70ad388887455f68aa645b833e43f76.data: Epidemiologists are professionals who investigate and analyze the determinants and distribution of disease, disability, and health outcomes. They play a crucial role in developing strategies for prevention and control of diseases. Key skills required for this role include reading comprehension, active learning, active listening, and effective communication. In addition, a strong foundation in biology, mathematics, and computer science is essential for conducting thorough research and analysis. A background in education and training, as well as proficiency in the English language, are also important for effectively communicating findings and recommendations to various stakeholders. Overall, epidemiologists play a vital role in understanding and addressing public health challenges through data-driven research and evidence-based interventions.

3b2dc7934e04f3e59e81dd485d6440246dda28b0.data: Medical Scientists, Except Epidemiologists, are professionals who conduct research to enhance human health by studying human diseases. They are involved in clinical investigations, research, and development activities. Key competencies for this role include reading comprehension, active learning, critical thinking, and writing skills. In terms of knowledge, proficiency in biology, chemistry, medicine, and dentistry is essential. This role requires a deep understanding of scientific principles and the ability to apply them in research and development projects aimed at improving human health outcomes.

d76317e86ce8b8edfedde41ce4bc110d75bb9760.data: Astronomers are professionals who observe, research, and interpret astronomical phenomena to expand our understanding of the universe and potentially solve practical problems. They possess key skills in reading comprehension, science, mathematics, writing, and active learning, allowing them to effectively analyze and communicate complex astronomical data. In addition, astronomers have a strong foundation in physics, mathematics, computers, and electronics, enabling them to utilize advanced technology and mathematical models in their research. By combining their expertise in various fields, astronomers play a crucial role in advancing our knowledge of the cosmos and addressing real-world challenges through their innovative research and problem-solving abilities.

5b9bd6a6e4e19dd411a9a27eea954b75ab6eb731.data: Physicists are professionals who conduct research to understand physical phenomena, develop theories based on observation and experiments, and create methods to apply physical laws and theories. They possess key skills in reading comprehension, science, mathematics, active learning, and writing. In terms of knowledge, physicists are well-versed in physics, mathematics, engineering and technology, computers and electronics, and education and training. Their expertise lies in analyzing data, conducting experiments, and formulating theories to advance our understanding of the natural world. With a strong foundation in mathematics and science, physicists play a crucial role in pushing the boundaries of knowledge and innovation in various fields.

d278c7b3a8f6f15a6f28f1e0792062820c150a26.data: Atmospheric and Space Scientists investigate atmospheric phenomena and interpret meteorological data from various sources such as surface and air stations, satellites, and radar to prepare reports and forecasts for public and other uses. This role requires a detailed knowledge of meteorology, including skills in reading comprehension, science, speaking, and active listening. Key knowledges in mathematics, computers and electronics, geography, physics, and the English language are essential for success in this field. Atmospheric and Space Scientists play a critical role in understanding and predicting weather patterns, providing valuable information for a wide range of applications.

62c4b504082305816eb21d4482837134c7b7bf94.data: Chemists are responsible for conducting both qualitative and quantitative chemical analyses in laboratory settings. They play a crucial role in quality control, process control, and the development of new products or knowledge within the field of chemistry. Key competencies for chemists include a strong foundation in science, proficiency in reading comprehension, writing, and mathematics, as well as critical thinking skills. In addition, chemists must possess in-depth knowledge of chemistry principles, mathematics, computers and electronics, and administrative procedures to effectively carry out their duties. By leveraging these key skills and knowledges, chemists are able to contribute to advancements in various industries and make significant contributions to scientific research and development.

6954d09b9d52d20fed833d732b2765504a303a6e.data: Materials Scientists are professionals who research and analyze the structures and chemical properties of a wide range of natural and synthetic materials, such as metals, alloys, rubber, ceramics, semiconductors, polymers, and glass. They work to develop new materials with specific properties or enhance existing materials for various products and applications. This role requires a strong foundation in science, including knowledge of engineering, mathematics, chemistry, and physics. Critical thinking, active listening, and strong communication skills are essential for success in this field. Materials Scientists may specialize in areas such as glass, ceramics, metallurgy, or polymers, and play a crucial role in advancing technology and innovation across industries.

4a73e8a5868111c5a6e389852df56f2b4bbbe857.data: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health, conduct research and investigations to identify and eliminate sources of pollutants or hazards impacting the environment and public health. They utilize a diverse range of scientific disciplines to collect, synthesize, study, and report on data derived from measurements of air, food, soil, water, and other sources. Critical competencies for this role include reading comprehension, writing, science, active listening, and critical thinking. Key knowledge areas include English language, administrative skills, biology, and proficiency in computers and electronics.

8e95608a3bb21706aff5f8f1bbd2d361327c4b4d.data: Climate Change Policy Analysts are responsible for researching and analyzing policy developments related to climate change. They provide recommendations for actions such as legislation, awareness campaigns, and fundraising approaches. Key skills for this role include reading comprehension, speaking, writing, and complex problem solving. In addition, a strong knowledge of mathematics, English language, law and government, geography, and law and government is essential for success in this field. Climate Change Policy Analysts play a crucial role in shaping policies and strategies to address the urgent issue of climate change.

131563aecaab764bb3da43451c1e48fd9dad71c2.data: Environmental Restoration Planners work closely with field and biology experts to coordinate the execution of restoration initiatives and create innovative solutions. They are responsible for analyzing and interpreting intricate scientific data to formulate effective strategies for restoration, monitoring, and management. Key competencies for this role include strong reading comprehension, writing, active listening, speaking, and critical thinking skills. In addition, a solid foundation in biology, geography, customer and personal service, and the English language is essential for success in this field. Environmental Restoration Planners play a crucial role in preserving and enhancing natural ecosystems through their expertise and dedication to environmental conservation.

346d5f352f0864bfaa9114c2e68add9e2ce964a3.data: Industrial ecologists apply principles from natural ecosystems to create models for optimizing industrial systems. By leveraging knowledge from physical and social sciences, they aim to enhance the efficient utilization of natural resources in the production and consumption of goods and services. Their work involves analyzing the interplay between societal issues, technical systems, and the environment. Critical competencies for industrial ecologists include strong skills in reading comprehension, writing, judgment and decision making, and critical thinking. They also possess key knowledge in mathematics, engineering and technology, computers and electronics, chemistry, and the English language. These competencies enable industrial ecologists to develop sustainable solutions that balance economic, environmental, and social considerations in industrial practices.

c3ad96605a1829a8bfb44047c7805942c22236e5.data: Geoscientists, excluding hydrologists and geographers, are professionals who analyze the Earth's composition, structure, and physical characteristics. They apply their expertise in geology, physics, and mathematics to explore for natural resources like oil, gas, minerals, and groundwater, as well as to address environmental issues such as waste disposal and land reclamation. These experts may also delve into the Earth's internal makeup, atmospheres, oceans, and various forces like magnetic, electrical, and gravitational. This diverse field encompasses mineralogists, paleontologists, stratigraphers, geodesists, and seismologists. Critical competencies for geoscientists include strong skills in reading comprehension, writing, science, speaking, and active listening, along with essential knowledge in geography, mathematics, computers and electronics, English language, and chemistry.

238c3d5a09f6bef27b3cc40ae01c3602a7be3e38.data: Hydrologists are tasked with researching the distribution, circulation, and physical properties of both underground and surface waters. They also analyze the form and intensity of precipitation, as well as its infiltration into the soil, movement through the earth, and eventual return to the ocean and atmosphere. To excel in this field, hydrologists must possess key skills such as reading comprehension, critical thinking, active learning, mathematics, and science. In addition, they should have a strong knowledge base in mathematics, geography, physics, engineering and technology, as well as computers and electronics. By combining these critical competencies, hydrologists are able to effectively study and understand the complex dynamics of water systems in various environments.

c4894153da75d015d43686bee1821eb9909fd455.data: Remote Sensing Scientists and Technologists apply remote sensing principles and methods to analyze data for various applications such as natural resource management, urban planning, and homeland security. They may develop new sensor systems, analytical techniques, or applications for existing systems. Key competencies for this role include strong skills in reading comprehension, writing, critical thinking, speaking, and mathematics. Additionally, a solid knowledge base in geography, mathematics, computers and electronics, engineering, and technology is essential for success in this field. By leveraging these competencies, professionals in this role can effectively analyze data and solve complex problems to make informed decisions in a variety of industries.

548edf1c5efc19f211f1ab361325cbde44b7fbbf.data: Economists are professionals who conduct research, prepare reports, and formulate plans to address economic issues related to the production and distribution of goods and services, as well as monetary and fiscal policy. They may collect and analyze economic and statistical data using sampling techniques and econometric methods. Key competencies for economists include reading comprehension, critical thinking, writing, speaking, and mathematics. In terms of knowledge, economists should have a strong understanding of mathematics, economics, and accounting, as well as proficiency in English language, computers and electronics, and education and training. These competencies and knowledge areas are essential for economists to effectively analyze and address complex economic problems in various industries and sectors.

e7bb3b2161c6423d2fa1ce9077c53461be3c8362.data: Environmental economists play a crucial role in analyzing the economic aspects of environmental protection and natural resource management. They utilize economic principles and statistical techniques to evaluate the benefits, costs, incentives, and impacts of various options related to water, air, land, and renewable energy resources. Key competencies for environmental economists include strong skills in reading comprehension, mathematics, writing, active listening, and critical thinking. In addition, they must possess knowledge in mathematics, economics and accounting, computers and electronics, and the English language. By combining these skills and knowledge, environmental economists are able to provide valuable insights and recommendations for sustainable environmental policies and practices.

5833efd5e3dfa81f483b9b202914967e21d0f5c4.data: Survey Researchers are professionals who plan, develop, and execute surveys to gather valuable data. They may analyze and interpret survey results, determine survey objectives, and suggest or test question wording. This role also includes overseeing survey teams and designing questionnaires. Key competencies for Survey Researchers include reading comprehension, mathematics, critical thinking, active listening, and writing. They must possess knowledge in mathematics, English language, and administration and management to effectively carry out their responsibilities in collecting and analyzing survey data.

aec244e4bcab4db6d479c3116f15a5f4d45da304.data: Industrial-Organizational Psychologists apply principles of psychology to various areas such as human resources, administration, management, sales, and marketing. They engage in activities such as policy planning, employee testing and selection, training and development, and organizational analysis. Working closely with management, they aim to improve worker productivity by organizing the work setting. Key competencies for this role include writing, reading comprehension, active listening, speaking, and critical thinking. In terms of knowledge, expertise in personnel and human resources, education and training, psychology, and the English language are essential for success in this field.

36e9fb732e579ccd060ff22ba6d6bcfbdc5e4c04.data: Clinical and Counseling Psychologists assess, diagnose, and treat mental and emotional disorders through observation, interviews, and psychological tests. They help individuals understand their problems by utilizing their knowledge of case history, patient interviews, and psychological theory. These professionals provide individual or group counseling services to support personal, social, educational, and vocational development. They may also design behavior modification programs and collaborate with medical personnel on treatment plans. Critical competencies for this role include social perceptiveness, active listening, reading comprehension, critical thinking, and a strong knowledge base in therapy, counseling, psychology, and the English language.

cdef6fb89316a25999e74af91c737dbaa746bd76.data: School Psychologists play a crucial role in diagnosing and implementing interventions to address educational, behavioral, and developmental issues that impact students' academic performance. They may work on an individual or schoolwide level to design and implement performance plans, evaluate progress, and provide counseling to students and families. With key skills in social perceptiveness, reading comprehension, and active listening, they are able to effectively assess and address student needs. Their knowledge in psychology, therapy, counseling, education, and sociology equips them to collaborate with other school personnel and provide comprehensive support to promote student success and well-being.

694334210a6c6559c1c9e1bca311e86811845d86.data: Neuropsychologists apply theories and principles of neuropsychology to evaluate and diagnose disorders of higher cerebral functioning in research and medical settings. They study the human brain and the impact of physiological states on cognition and behavior, often formulating and administering treatment programs. Key competencies for this role include reading comprehension, social perceptiveness, writing, speaking, and active listening. Key knowledge areas include psychology, therapy and counseling, education and training, English language, and sociology and anthropology. Neuropsychologists play a critical role in understanding and addressing complex cognitive disorders through a combination of specialized skills and knowledge in the field of neuropsychology.

3d4c8e0c3e816697e6bb250275e807de544c58ca.data: Clinical Neuropsychologists specialize in assessing and diagnosing patients with neurobehavioral issues stemming from various nervous system disorders. These professionals work with individuals affected by conditions like neurodegenerative disorders, traumatic brain injury, seizure disorders, and learning disabilities. Following a thorough diagnosis, Clinical Neuropsychologists recommend appropriate treatment options, which may include therapy, medication, or surgery. They also play a crucial role in evaluating patients before and after neurosurgical procedures, such as deep brain stimulation. To excel in this role, Clinical Neuropsychologists must possess key skills such as social perceptiveness, reading comprehension, active listening, and writing. Additionally, a strong foundation in psychology, therapy and counseling, education and training, as well as proficiency in the English language are essential for success in this field.

2c5f1b1c70ac87626df58f9ba42bae1fa30e5758.data: Sociologists study human society and social behavior, analyzing groups, social institutions, and various organizations such as religious, political, and business entities. They examine group behavior, origins, growth, and the impact of group activities on individuals. Key competencies for sociologists include reading comprehension, writing, active listening, speaking, and critical thinking. They must possess knowledge in sociology and anthropology, English language, education and training, philosophy and theology. By utilizing these skills and knowledge, sociologists are able to conduct in-depth research and analysis on societal dynamics and interactions.

299b81fde17870cb763987773cf1e71afba86d4f.data: Urban and Regional Planners are professionals who develop comprehensive plans and programs for the efficient utilization of land and physical facilities in various jurisdictions, including towns, cities, counties, and metropolitan areas. They possess key skills such as reading comprehension, active listening, speaking, critical thinking, judgment, and decision-making. In addition, they have essential knowledge in areas such as geography, customer and personal service, English language, and law and government. By combining their expertise in planning with their critical competencies, Urban and Regional Planners play a crucial role in shaping the sustainable development and growth of urban areas.

051c770c193d247360369e0b2203f5f444d9f165.data: Anthropologists and archeologists are professionals who delve into the origins, development, and behaviors of human beings, studying various aspects such as way of life, language, and physical characteristics across different regions. They engage in systematic recovery and examination of material evidence like tools and pottery to uncover the history, customs, and living habits of past civilizations. Key competencies for this role include reading comprehension, writing, speaking, critical thinking, and active listening. In terms of knowledge, expertise in sociology, anthropology, history, archeology, education, English language, and geography are essential for success in this field.

26906281b4dd4b4808ec3542a8c98b4b6c3fd5f7.data: Geographers are professionals who study the Earth's surface, analyzing the interactions between physical and cultural phenomena. They conduct research on various aspects of a region, such as landforms, climates, and ecosystems, as well as the spatial implications of human activities, including social, economic, and political factors. Geographers also investigate the interdependence between regions at different scales, from local to global. To excel in this field, geographers must possess key skills such as writing, speaking, and active listening, along with a strong foundation in geography, education, computers, sociology, and anthropology. By leveraging their expertise in these areas, geographers are able to provide valuable insights into the complex relationships that shape our world.

5011626a686a9146c51acb3b9f91c92789db0386.data: Historians are professionals who research, analyze, and interpret the past using a variety of sources such as government records, newspapers, photographs, and personal diaries. They possess critical competencies in reading comprehension, writing, speaking, and critical thinking. In terms of knowledge, historians are well-versed in history and archeology, as well as geography and the English language. Their work involves uncovering and documenting historical events and trends, providing valuable insights into the past for future generations to learn from and understand.

05e0f4bdc417ae36924cb3cc8add71db5f80dca2.data: Political Scientists are experts in studying the intricacies of political systems, including their origin, development, and operation. They delve into topics such as public opinion, political decision-making, and ideology, while also analyzing the structure and functioning of governments and other political entities. This role may involve conducting public opinion surveys, analyzing election results, and examining public documents to gain insights into political dynamics. Critical competencies for Political Scientists include strong skills in reading comprehension, speaking, critical thinking, active listening, and writing. Additionally, they possess key knowledge in areas such as the English language, education and training, law and government, sociology and anthropology, and mathematics. These competencies are essential for Political Scientists to effectively analyze and interpret complex political phenomena and contribute valuable insights to the field.

9938e1e928929cede97c79be2a118f71a15f0c3c.data: Transportation planners are responsible for preparing studies for proposed transportation projects by gathering, compiling, and analyzing data related to the use and operation of transportation systems. They develop transportation models or simulations to assess the impact of proposed projects. Key competencies for transportation planners include reading comprehension, critical thinking, active listening, writing, and speaking. They must have knowledge in geography, transportation, computers and electronics, mathematics, and transportation systems to effectively carry out their duties. By utilizing these skills and knowledge, transportation planners play a crucial role in shaping the future of transportation infrastructure.

09e6718f71efd5d8fbdd8fe080df91fffb92dc93.data: Agricultural Technicians work closely with agricultural scientists to conduct research in plant, fiber, and animal studies, as well as assist in animal breeding and nutrition. They are responsible for setting up and maintaining laboratory equipment, collecting samples from crops and animals, and preparing specimens or recording data for biology and life science experiments. Agricultural Technicians also conduct tests and experiments to enhance crop yield and quality, as well as improve plant and animal resistance to disease and insects. Key competencies for this role include reading comprehension, critical thinking, writing, and active listening. In terms of knowledge, Agricultural Technicians should have a strong understanding of food production, chemistry, mechanical processes, biology, and food production techniques.

088378d748da16b0f3aa3ee9cec1ea2bd2f4ab80.data: Precision Agriculture Technicians utilize geospatial technologies like GIS and GPS to enhance agricultural production and management practices. They apply these tools for tasks such as pest scouting, site-specific pesticide application, yield mapping, and variable-rate irrigation. Additionally, they may use computers to analyze maps and remote sensing images to compare physical topography with data on soils, fertilizer, pests, and weather. Critical competencies for this role include strong reading comprehension and active listening skills, as well as knowledge in computers and electronics, customer and personal service, mathematics, sales and marketing, and food production.

5675d9dc8dd957a788f45e33a2e8f0b331da120a.data: Food Science Technicians work closely with food scientists and technologists to conduct a variety of tests to analyze the physical and chemical characteristics of food and beverage products. They play a crucial role in research and development, quality control, packaging, processing, and utilization of food items. Key competencies for this role include strong reading comprehension, active listening, writing, and speaking skills. Additionally, a solid foundation in chemistry, production and processing techniques, computer technology, biology, and food production is essential for success in this field. Food Science Technicians are integral members of the food industry, contributing to the advancement and improvement of food products through their expertise and knowledge.

e129ed555fb0f0531689c42e7ac8f9bd8afb8b4e.data: Biological Technicians play a crucial role in supporting biological and medical scientists by assisting in various laboratory tasks. They are responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining laboratory instruments and equipment, monitoring experiments, collecting data and samples, making observations, and calculating and recording results. Additionally, they may analyze organic substances such as blood, food, and drugs. Key competencies for Biological Technicians include strong reading comprehension, critical thinking, and active learning skills. They must also possess knowledge in biology, chemistry, computers and electronics, and the English language to effectively carry out their duties in the laboratory setting.

9a2ac9c345f57357208b9baf153065b7ee4be5a6.data: Chemical Technicians play a crucial role in the research and development of new products and processes by conducting chemical and physical laboratory tests. They assist scientists in making qualitative and quantitative analyses of solids, liquids, and gaseous materials to ensure quality control and environmental standards are met. This role requires a strong foundation in chemistry and related sciences, as well as proficiency in reading comprehension, critical thinking, and mathematics. Chemical Technicians must possess a deep understanding of chemistry and be able to apply their knowledge in practical applications. Additionally, strong communication skills, particularly in English language, are essential for effectively collaborating with scientists and conveying research findings.

936252ac2f00905ca0cfcd0adcf7c0655d0e1aaf.data: Environmental Science and Protection Technicians, Including Health, play a crucial role in monitoring and investigating environmental pollution that impacts public health. Working under the guidance of environmental scientists or engineers, these technicians conduct laboratory and field tests to collect samples of gases, soil, water, and other materials for analysis. Key competencies for this role include strong reading comprehension, active listening, writing, and speaking skills. Additionally, technicians must possess knowledge in customer and personal service, biology, chemistry, computers and electronics, and mathematics to effectively carry out their duties in safeguarding the environment and human health.

c665ff149374d37b04582e03e04eb6db4a2887fe.data: Geological Technicians, Except Hydrologic Technicians, play a crucial role in supporting scientists and engineers by utilizing various measuring instruments to gather data on valuable resources such as metallic ore, minerals, gas, coal, and petroleum. They are responsible for analyzing mud and drill cuttings, as well as charting pressure, temperature, and other well characteristics. Key competencies for this role include strong reading comprehension, active listening, writing, and critical thinking skills. In addition, geological technicians must possess knowledge in computers and electronics, mathematics, geography, engineering and technology, and physics to effectively carry out their duties in laboratory, exploration, and production activities.

aea3ef7f1f973e464e8cc96c8300a9ca6b3f43bb.data: Nuclear Technicians play a crucial role in assisting nuclear physicists and engineers in various laboratory and power generation activities. They are responsible for operating and maintaining nuclear testing and research equipment, as well as ensuring quality control measures are in place. Monitoring radiation levels is also a key aspect of their job. Key skills for Nuclear Technicians include operations monitoring, active listening, and reading comprehension. In terms of knowledge, they must have a strong understanding of mechanical principles, physics, public safety and security protocols, as well as education and training techniques. A background in chemistry is also essential for success in this field.

60fde5df69c131d1d007274ce1470b1e05afb324.data: Nuclear Monitoring Technicians are responsible for collecting and testing samples to monitor the outcomes of nuclear experiments and detect any contamination of humans, facilities, and the environment. This role requires a strong foundation in critical thinking and reading comprehension skills to analyze data effectively. Active listening is crucial for understanding instructions and communicating findings. Proficiency in mathematics, computers and electronics, physics, and chemistry is essential for conducting accurate tests and interpreting results. Additionally, a solid grasp of the English language is necessary for documenting findings and communicating with colleagues. Overall, Nuclear Monitoring Technicians play a critical role in ensuring the safety and integrity of nuclear operations through their monitoring and analysis skills.

d4b614decd4f4489b02b551fecfad60e211099fd.data: Social Science Research Assistants support social scientists in various research activities, including laboratory experiments and survey projects. They play a crucial role in preparing research findings for publication and assisting with data analysis, quality control, and data management tasks. Key competencies for this role include strong reading comprehension, active listening, writing, and mathematical skills. Additionally, knowledge of the English language, administrative procedures, computer technology, and mathematics is essential for success in this field. Overall, Social Science Research Assistants play a vital role in the research process, contributing to the advancement of knowledge in the social sciences.

c89a299dfd11dd1934d5f9972f380bcbf008393a.data: Forest and Conservation Technicians play a crucial role in assisting with the conservation of natural resources such as soil, water, and forests. They work under the guidance of foresters to gather data on forest tracts, including size, content, and condition. Additionally, they may lead forest workers in tasks related to forest propagation and fire prevention. These technicians also support conservation scientists in managing and protecting rangelands and wildlife habitats. Key skills for this role include reading comprehension, critical thinking, and monitoring, while essential knowledge areas encompass geography, customer service, mathematics, and public safety. Overall, Forest and Conservation Technicians are instrumental in preserving and improving our natural environment.

054d741557ece9afad9641e30a5b4f1bfc015184.data: Forensic Science Technicians play a crucial role in criminal investigations by collecting, identifying, classifying, and analyzing physical evidence. They conduct tests on various substances and weapons, such as fiber, hair, and tissue, to determine their relevance to the case at hand. These technicians may also serve as expert witnesses in court, providing testimony on evidence and crime laboratory techniques. Specializing in areas such as ballistics, fingerprinting, handwriting, or biochemistry, they possess key skills in reading comprehension, active listening, writing, speaking, and critical thinking. Additionally, their knowledge of law and government, computers and electronics, public safety and security, education and training, and chemistry is essential for carrying out their duties effectively.

20ceb74c0ae89092542436629b4e3dc476097f69.data: Quality Control Analysts are responsible for conducting tests to assess the quality of raw materials, bulk intermediate, and finished products. They may also perform stability sample tests to ensure product consistency. Key competencies for this role include proficiency in Quality Control Analysis, Monitoring, and Reading Comprehension. In addition, a strong knowledge base in Mathematics, Chemistry, and Production and Processing is essential for success in this field. Quality Control Analysts play a critical role in ensuring that products meet quality standards and specifications, making their attention to detail and analytical skills indispensable in the manufacturing industry.

e87b458e26aab107361b28b6afb091c5f1a1c89a.data: Remote Sensing Technicians play a crucial role in utilizing remote sensing technologies to support various scientific endeavors, including natural resource management, urban planning, and homeland security. They are responsible for preparing flight plans and configuring sensors for aerial trips, contributing to the collection of valuable data for analysis and decision-making. Key competencies for success in this role include strong skills in reading comprehension, mathematics, critical thinking, active listening, and writing. Additionally, a solid knowledge base in geography, computers and electronics, and mathematics is essential for effectively carrying out the duties of a Remote Sensing Technician. By possessing these critical competencies, individuals in this field can make significant contributions to the advancement of scientific research and applications in a variety of important areas.

124ee1ca222fb094a777cd2be3f93c4f74af12fb.data: Occupational Health and Safety Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring the well-being of individuals in various work environments. They review, evaluate, and analyze work environments to identify potential hazards and develop programs to control and prevent diseases or injuries caused by various agents. This may involve conducting inspections and enforcing compliance with health and safety regulations. Key competencies for this role include strong reading and active listening skills, as well as proficiency in writing. Additionally, specialists should have knowledge in areas such as education and training, customer service, English language, chemistry, and mathematics. Whether working in the public or private sector, Occupational Health and Safety Specialists are essential in promoting a safe and healthy work environment for all individuals.

6215e48792e2c65ef570c1c9e589681ad2e30f7e.data: Occupational Health and Safety Technicians play a crucial role in collecting and analyzing data on work environments to support occupational health and safety specialists. They are responsible for implementing and evaluating programs aimed at reducing risks related to chemicals, physical hazards, biological agents, and ergonomic factors in the workplace. Critical competencies for this role include active listening, critical thinking, and strong reading comprehension skills. Additionally, technicians must possess knowledge in areas such as education and training, the English language, customer and personal service, engineering, and mathematics to effectively carry out their duties and ensure the well-being of workers.

d634b72d689cd34d942b3828b256f5610014ace1.data: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors play a crucial role in advising and supporting individuals struggling with various addictions and behavioral issues, including alcohol, tobacco, drugs, gambling, and eating disorders. They provide counseling to individuals, families, and groups, as well as participate in prevention programs to help address and overcome these challenges. Key competencies for this role include social perceptiveness, active listening, and speaking, as well as a strong foundation in therapy and counseling, psychology, and customer and personal service. These counselors must possess the ability to empathetically listen to clients, understand their needs, and provide effective guidance and support to help them on their journey towards recovery and wellness.

4c04181498cd283cce1bc4c5f13c3e7cf9670cc8.data: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors play a crucial role in advising and assisting students with educational and vocational guidance services. They utilize key skills such as social perceptiveness, active listening, reading comprehension, and speaking to effectively communicate and understand the needs of their clients. In addition, they possess key knowledges in customer and personal service, education and training, English language, administrative tasks, and therapy and counseling techniques. By combining these competencies, counselors and advisors are able to provide valuable support and guidance to individuals seeking direction in their academic and career paths.

22d71074431135988788c08ffb022904faa75b72.data: Marriage and Family Therapists diagnose and treat mental and emotional disorders within the framework of marriage and family systems, utilizing psychotherapeutic and family systems theories and techniques. They provide services to individuals, couples, and families to address diagnosed nervous and mental disorders. Critical competencies for this role include social perceptiveness, active listening, and reading comprehension. Key knowledge areas encompass therapy and counseling, psychology, and customer and personal service. These professionals play a crucial role in helping individuals and families navigate and overcome mental health challenges within the context of their relationships and family dynamics.

1089ce4ba1336956bfd9bd84313d2407f68525a0.data: Mental Health Counselors play a crucial role in promoting mental and emotional well-being through counseling and advising individuals and groups. They focus on prevention and intervention for a wide range of mental health issues, including addiction, family dynamics, stress management, and self-esteem. Critical competencies for this role include social perceptiveness, active listening, and reading comprehension. In-depth knowledge of psychology, therapy, counseling, and customer service is essential for effectively supporting clients in navigating their mental health challenges.

35de92da658dc97efe41acf240273d9437e70772.data: Rehabilitation counselors play a crucial role in assisting individuals facing various challenges, such as birth defects, illness, accidents, and aging, to enhance their independence and employability. They provide personalized counseling and support to help clients cope with personal, social, and vocational difficulties. By assessing client needs, they develop and implement rehabilitation programs that may involve vocational training, job placement, and counseling. These professionals also coordinate activities for residents of care facilities, ensuring they receive the necessary support and services. Key competencies for rehabilitation counselors include social perceptiveness, active listening, and monitoring, as well as knowledge in therapy and counseling, customer service, psychology, and education. Their expertise in these areas enables them to effectively support individuals in overcoming challenges and achieving their goals for independence and employment.

8644849afd58438d7e5d7059d0d6920f7443f8ad.data: Child, Family, and School Social Workers play a crucial role in providing social services and support to enhance the well-being of children and families. They work to improve the social and psychological functioning of children, while also focusing on maximizing family welfare and academic success. This may involve assisting parents, facilitating adoptions, and finding suitable foster homes for vulnerable children. In educational settings, they address issues such as teenage pregnancy, behavioral problems, and truancy, often collaborating with teachers to provide guidance and support. Key competencies for this role include active listening, social perceptiveness, critical thinking, and effective communication skills. Additionally, a strong knowledge base in areas such as therapy, psychology, and customer service is essential for success in this field.

7fb9dbed044149ed6c94ec286d49754b5d59add7.data: Healthcare Social Workers play a crucial role in providing psychosocial support to individuals, families, and groups facing chronic, acute, or terminal illnesses. They offer counseling, information, and referrals to other services, while also advising family caregivers. In addition to case and care management, they may implement interventions to promote health and address healthcare access barriers. Key competencies for this role include social perceptiveness, active listening, and service orientation, along with skills in reading comprehension and speaking. Knowledge in therapy and counseling, psychology, customer and personal service, sociology, and anthropology are essential for success in this field.

e2a40bbc77c3b639cb338695aac933dae1b1aeb5.data: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers assess and provide treatment for individuals struggling with mental health, emotional, and substance abuse issues, including alcohol, tobacco, and drug abuse. They engage in a range of activities such as individual and group therapy, crisis intervention, case management, client advocacy, prevention, and education. Key competencies for this role include social perceptiveness, reading comprehension, active listening, and speaking. In addition, a strong knowledge base in therapy and counseling, psychology, customer and personal service is essential for effectively supporting and guiding individuals towards improved mental health and well-being.

2b2802353da518be9ebb6da5586726bd90ae961d.data: Health Education Specialists play a crucial role in promoting and maintaining healthy lifestyles within communities. By utilizing data to assess community needs, they develop and implement programs aimed at encouraging healthy behaviors and environments. They serve as a valuable resource for individuals, healthcare professionals, and the community at large, while also managing fiscal resources for health education initiatives. Key competencies for Health Education Specialists include effective communication skills such as speaking, active listening, and writing, as well as a strong foundation in customer service, administrative tasks, education, psychology, and the English language. These professionals are instrumental in bridging the gap between health systems, providers, insurers, and patients to address both individual and population health needs.

4643be776776af13c7bc59ccada1b0d5ef250358.data: Probation officers and correctional treatment specialists play a crucial role in the rehabilitation of law offenders, whether they are in custody or on probation or parole. They provide social services and make recommendations for rehabilitation plans, treatment options, and conditions of release. Critical competencies for this role include social perceptiveness, reading comprehension, active listening, and effective communication skills. In addition, knowledge of psychology, therapy and counseling, public safety and security, law and government, and the English language are essential for success in this field. Overall, probation officers and correctional treatment specialists must possess a strong understanding of human behavior, the criminal justice system, and effective intervention strategies to help offenders successfully reintegrate into society.

c544aee92a0da7af4dc44a813abefd0f991a50a9.data: Social and Human Service Assistants play a crucial role in supporting various social and human service providers across fields such as psychology, rehabilitation, and social work. They assist clients in accessing benefits and community services, as well as help in developing and implementing programs to address issues like substance abuse, relationships, and dependent care. Key competencies for this role include strong communication skills, social perceptiveness, and active listening abilities. Additionally, knowledge in areas such as customer service, psychology, therapy, and counseling is essential for effectively assisting clients and supporting social workers in their programs.

1c292568be596c0b54ac0e38c9388cbdf9508cbf.data: Community Health Workers play a vital role in promoting health and wellness within communities. They assist individuals in adopting healthy behaviors and serve as advocates for their health needs, helping them effectively communicate with healthcare providers and social service agencies. Acting as liaisons and advocates, they implement programs to promote and improve individual and community health. Community Health Workers may also provide health-related preventive services such as screenings for blood pressure, glaucoma, and hearing. They collect data to identify community health needs and possess key skills such as social perceptiveness, active listening, speaking, and reading comprehension. In addition, they have knowledge in areas such as customer and personal service, administrative tasks, education and training, and psychology.

22ba4a6698b0f7db35428042f920b6125702f30e.data: Clergy members are responsible for leading religious worship and providing spiritual guidance to their congregation. They conduct ceremonies and rituals in accordance with the beliefs and practices of their faith. In addition to leading worship services, clergy offer moral support and counseling to members in need. To excel in this role, clergy must possess strong social perceptiveness and active listening skills to understand and address the needs of their community. They must also have a deep knowledge of philosophy, theology, and counseling techniques to provide effective guidance and support. Education and training in sociology and anthropology are also important for understanding the diverse backgrounds and beliefs of their congregation. Overall, clergy play a vital role in providing spiritual and moral guidance to their community.

235fbfe5287ba126d97d478df9cd44ea48c07a2f.data: Directors of Religious Activities and Education play a crucial role in coordinating and designing programs to promote religious education and activities within a denominational group. They may also provide counseling and guidance on a variety of issues including marital, health, financial, and religious matters. Key competencies for this role include social perceptiveness, effective communication skills (speaking, reading comprehension, active listening), as well as knowledge in philosophy and theology, education and training, customer and personal service, administration and management, and proficiency in the English language. This role requires a deep understanding of religious principles and practices, as well as the ability to effectively engage and support individuals within the community.

ecdd7b21f82459ca9d84e2afd569b7629546c1a8.data: Lawyers are legal professionals who represent clients in various legal proceedings, including criminal and civil litigation. They are responsible for drafting legal documents, providing legal advice, and managing transactions for their clients. Lawyers may specialize in a specific area of law or have a broad practice across multiple areas. Key competencies for lawyers include active listening, critical thinking, persuasion, reading comprehension, and writing. They must have a strong knowledge of law and government, as well as proficiency in the English language. Additionally, lawyers must excel in customer and personal service to effectively advocate for their clients.

ccda9f5f93e578d157d6cca8870c683af19dda72.data: Judicial Law Clerks play a crucial role in supporting judges by assisting in court proceedings and conducting legal research. They are responsible for preparing legal documents and ensuring the smooth operation of the judicial process. Key competencies for this role include strong reading comprehension skills to understand complex legal documents and critical thinking abilities to analyze and interpret laws effectively. Additionally, proficiency in writing is essential for drafting accurate and concise legal documents. Knowledge of law and government is vital, as well as a strong command of the English language. Administrative skills are also important for managing court procedures efficiently. Overall, Judicial Law Clerks must possess a combination of legal knowledge, language proficiency, and critical thinking skills to excel in this role.

89a81a695d80d8adc5259b2fedd53e0593d0233d.data: Administrative Law Judges, Adjudicators, and Hearing Officers are responsible for conducting hearings and making decisions on claims related to government programs. They may also be involved in identifying and recording objects, as well as installing and arranging them in exhibits. Book or document conservators are also included in this role. Key competencies for this position include reading comprehension, active listening, writing, and fine arts knowledge. Additionally, a strong background in history and archeology, administration and management, English language, and chemistry is essential for success in this field.

Their tasks involve acquiring, cataloging, and circulating library materials, as well as providing user services like organizing information, offering instruction on accessing information, and operating library media equipment.
